title: Self-supervised biomedical signal representation learning from intrapartum cardiotocography: stability, ablation, and exploratory neonatal risk enrichment
description: Reviewer 5 revision code, manuscript source, figures, supplementary tables and reproducibility audits for a public CTG representation-learning study. The release adds patient-grouped JNU-CTG label-free pretraining, frozen-encoder morphology probes, five-seed stability, channel and sampling sensitivities, a prespecified promotion gate, and the final source-controlled Figure 1 redesign. JNU-to-CTU pretraining transferred morphology information but did not establish improved neonatal-risk enrichment; JNU results therefore remain supplementary and are not external outcome validation.
